DjVu Reader decoder based on djvu-rs 0.43.0
Copyright (c) 2026 Lev Matyushkin and djvu-rs contributors.
Upstream: https://github.com/matyushkin/djvu-rs
Upstream revision: ad6cd1b35eedb2f7ecc3fdbbdf4bf80ea5823cf9
License: MIT; see LICENSE.txt. Third-party dependencies are described in
THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.txt; the exact source used is in strict-source.zip.

Reader integration changes to src/wasm.rs, 2026-10-28: expose strict full-page
rendering, unsupported-layer rejection, bounded input/cache options, original rotation and outline metadata.
The binaries are local builds, not the original npm release binaries.

Build: Rust 1.99.1, wasm-bindgen-cli 0.2.129, wasm-opt 117, locked Cargo
dependencies, features=wasm. Scalar: cargo build --locked --release --target
wasm32-unknown-unknown --features wasm; SIMD adds RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+simd128'.
Run wasm-bindgen --target web, then wasm-opt -O --enable-reference-types
(and --enable-simd for the SIMD binary). This archive excludes test corpora and
is not a statement that every runtime interaction or legal obligation is met.

source archive SHA-256: 770d44f46001190f0b3ff9d15903ace50788b2c2e68a83714720c2a0bfa7c532
scalar wasm SHA-256: a03526f445b48c4f99043ce282e333828eae0c956148693f52788fe6787c5b33
SIMD wasm SHA-256: a99c0e299e9526d084c845f2ab5d988c0cfc05e75f20d14a84ed4c55fe5d47a3

Reader range integration, 2026-10-30: `range-source-v13.zip` derives from the
same 0.43.0 strict source. Its `wasm-lazy` build adds bounded byte ranges,
strict native-page rendering, original rotation/text/outline, and one parsed
page at a time. The original eager API remains for verified OCR and fallback.
The third-party notices above already cover the wasm-lazy dependency graph.
Build with Rust 1.99.1 and wasm-bindgen-cli 0.2.129: `cargo build --offline
--locked --release --target wasm32-unknown-unknown --features wasm-lazy`;
the SIMD build adds `RUSTFLAGS='-C target-feature=+simd128'`. Run
`wasm-bindgen --target web` on each build. No wasm-opt pass was used.
range-source-v13.zip SHA-256: ab9fc6128ce8ff743600809d85afe36cf308620b7fd50badb2fb732e01510438
range scalar wasm SHA-256: a23e0b3e3a443f348161a57506d2f434d4dbbcdaeb89500642688539c3a9ca36
range SIMD wasm SHA-256: 025029b02a7c6e13f3d8a612077ebc5efae6fc23b02debbc754b4e8da9bca424
